text:
alex: Heads up — opened a terraform change to move the autoscaler metrics secret in Vault (path rename). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4321 :eyes:
alex: This seemed to break HPA in staging because the k8s secret wasn't updated from Vault -> kubernetes_secret sync.
sam: Can you paste the terraform plan snippet?
alex: ```
# terraform plan snippet
+ resource "vault_generic_secret" "autoscaler_metrics" {
  path = "secret/data/autoscaler/metrics"
  data_json = <<EOF
{"token":"(redacted)"}
EOF
}
+ resource "kubernetes_secret" "autoscaler_metrics_k8s" {
  metadata { name = "autoscaler-metrics" namespace = "kube-system" }
  data = { token = vault_generic_secret.autoscaler_metrics.data_json }
}
```

maria: Reminder: VPA doesn't use creds, HPA (metrics-server) does. If the k8s secret name changed, metrics-adapter can't talk to Vault token.
alex: I only changed vault path; I added the sync resource but didn't run apply in staging before the deploy :rotating_light:
lee: Check the metrics-adapter deployment env var `METRICS_TOKEN_SECRET` — that's what it reads. If it's `autoscaler-metrics-v2` but k8s has `autoscaler-metrics`, they won't match.
alex: Confirmed — k8s secret name mismatch in staging. HPA stopped receiving external metrics.
maria: Quick mitigation: run `terraform apply -target=module.vault.vault_generic_secret.autoscaler_metrics` then `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/metrics-adapter`
alex: Ran that, restarted the deployment, HPA recovered in staging. Need to make the name stable so this doesn't happen on next change.
sam: Provisioner itself doesn't reference that secret, but Karpenter webhook or metrics-adapter might. Double-check karpenter controller ConfigMap and webhook config for secret refs.
lee: Also ensure the terraform module that creates the k8s secret sets `metadata.name = var.autoscaler_secret_name` instead of deriving from the Vault path. We had an incident earlier where autogenerated names caused confusion.
alex: I'll open a follow-up PR to make the name explicit and add a post-apply restart hook. Draft HCL snippet I'm planning to add:
```hcl
module "autoscaler_secret" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules.git//vault-to-k8s?ref=v1.2"
  vault_path = "secret/data/autoscaler/metrics"
  k8s_name  = "autoscaler-metrics"
}
```
maria: SGTM. Add a small provisioner/local-exec to trigger `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/metrics-adapter` or add it to the CI pipeline post-apply. Also link the change to the runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/autoscaler-metrics
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] terraform plan for PR#4321 completed: 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy
lee: +1 to adding a canary and coordinating with eng-sre for low-traffic window. If the HPA metric name changed upstream, we should also update the HPA manifest.
maria: Example HPA manifest check (we changed metric name last quarter):
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: worker-api
spec:
  metrics:
  - type: External
    external:
      metric:
        name: custom/autoscaler/requests_per_second
        selector:
          matchLabels:
            service: worker
      target:
        type: AverageValue
        averageValue: "50"
```
sam: Anything blocking merge besides adding the name var + runbook step?
alex: That's it. I'll update the PR with the var, add the post-apply note, and tag eng-sre for a canary window. Will post updates by EOD.
maria: Thanks for the quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
